hadith: The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'Have Taqwa of Allah wherever you are, and follow an evil deed with a good one to wipe it out, and treat people with good behavior.'
The Messenger of Allah used to say: 'O You Who makes hearts steadfast make our hearts steadfast in adhering to Your religion.'

Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Allah created mercy, and He placed one part of it among his creation, they show mercy to one another by it, and there are ninety-nine mercies with Allah.'
